text.text_excerpt: Wow! I passed by this bar one weekend and thought what is that? And didn't notice a sign. The next weekend, I met friends here and realized the Domino out front IS the sign. Gotcha. What a great happy hour! And what a fun and spacious bar. First the HH: It runs 7 days a week! from 3-6. Yes please. I know I enjoyed $5 cocktails, but I remember beer and wine specials. OMG I love the giant wrap around bar. So many places to sit and the vintage booths are amazing. They have all sorts of events and popups happening too. Definitely a spot to cross town for!

How does one even start a review of her favorite bar in New Orleans.... I'm almost emotional thinking about the greatness of The Domino. First off... Its name is cooler than your favorite bar name... You can say what you want, but you know it... You know just by the name I'm gonna have a good time and I'm going to leave this bar cooler than when I first entered this bar! SPACE... Listen..... The Domino has ALL THE space...I really mean it.... ALL OF IT.. When you walking up to the bar, you wouldn't expect it, but it's a lot of room. You can have a pretty large legit size event here. I actually had my first Fancy Ladies Happy Hour Society Event here and there was enough space to have three...

This has become my favorite bar. The drinks are just spectacular! Every single one I've tried has been delicious. The prices are reasonable. They have food vendors sometimes inside and food trucks outside at times. The bartenders are super friendly. The bar is so spacious and I am in love with the horseshoe shaped bar. The bathrooms are nice and clean. Trivia is a great time! I've been to trivia maybe 3 times there and had a blast. I also had a birthday happy hour there, which was great. There was supposed to be a food truck there that day but it cancelled because it was supposed to rain & the lovely bartenders told me and my friends that we could totally order food and bring it in, which...
